newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen falling further amid selling.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen falling further amid selling.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) may continue to fall amid selling pressure by investors wary about the future of the country, brokers said.

"Investors are nervous about the persistent bearish trend of the market. This is because of a nagging power disruptions hurting the economy and the opposition strike on Sunday," said broker Shakil Rizvi.
The DSE benchmark index closed 65.10 points or 4.83 percent down at 1,280.27 on a turnover of 77.94 million taka on Wednesday.
